name: Xing Ming
source: An Astrologian hailing from distant lands, Xing Ming traveled to the land on a diplomatic mission. Mischievous as well as versatile in combat, Xing Ming can heal and empower allies as well as barrage enemies with powerful magic. His age is something he loves keeping people guessing.
